environment.concurrency_note: single-threaded, sequential calls -- no concurrent/async execution measured

one_time_context_build.description: Parses all 18 capture files' stateful CSVs into the pooled per-capture context table (src/features/stateful_context.py). Paid once per enrichment refresh, not per query or per session. n=3 repeats is too small for a meaningful percentile -- reporting min/mean/max, not median/p95, to avoid a false-precision claim over so few samples.

marginal_per_escalated_session.description: Dict lookup into the already-built pooled context + majority-vote decision over the top-3 discriminative stateful features (src/models/cascade.py:_stage2_vote). This is the cost actually paid at escalation time, on top of Stage 1's per-query cost.

one_stage_vs_two_stage_comparison.note: Stage 2's marginal cost is paid once per SESSION (18 sessions total in this dataset), not once per query -- effectively negligible per-query overhead even for the 38.9% of test rows that belong to an escalated session (see results/metrics/cascade_report.json:pct_test_rows_escalated_to_stage2). The one-time context build (27.8s for 18 files) is the real cost driver, and it is a batch/offline operation, not part of the online query path.
